The game

A sports arcade that still feels like volleyball.

Rally, not button-mash

Modes

Five ways in. One language of play.

  • Quick Match Pick opponent, format, and difficulty.
  • Tournament Five rounds. One loss and you are out.
  • Co-Op / Versus Two players, one device — same team or opposite sides.
  • Survival Waves ramp. Lives run out. Rank is the trophy.
  • Online One tap to a real opponent. Rematch supported.

A fictional squad with real roles.

Liberos, setters, middles, opposites — stats and bonuses drive how each player hits, blocks, and covers. 1v1 or 2v2. Easy / Normal / Hard.
